# Worker Agents Skills

This repository bundles the baseline skills installed by [Worker
Agents](https://github.com/agents-dev/workerAgents).

The bundled skills are available under [`skills/`](skills/):

- `mcp-duckgo` — imported from `aahl/skills@mcp-duckgo`.
- `image-search` — imported from `z0gsh1u/oh-my-writing-skill@image-search`.
- `gauntlet-loop` — imported from `robonuggets/gauntlet-loop@gauntlet-loop`.
- `load-sketchfab-threejs` — local asset inspection, normalization, and Three.js/PlayCanvas A/B viewer skill.
- `opencode-zen-completions` — use the OpenCode Zen chat completions API for implementation work.

The original upstream licenses are preserved in
[`third-party-licenses/`](third-party-licenses/).
---
opencode.yml
name: OpenCode
run-name: "OpenCode #${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}${{ github.event.issue.title && format(' — {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: Existing issue to run
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: opencode-issue-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event.action == 'opened' && contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'OpenCode'))
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-prepare.yml@73c5fea042dfb7c81e7f566fec2aa9c8ca8070ae
    with:
      runtime_ref: 73c5fea042dfb7c81e7f566fec2aa9c8ca8070ae

  opencode:
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.approved == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: read
      pull-requests: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-reusable.yml@73c5fea042dfb7c81e7f566fec2aa9c8ca8070ae
    with:
      runtime_ref: 73c5fea042dfb7c81e7f566fec2aa9c8ca8070ae
      issue_number: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_number }}
      request: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.request }}
      issue_title: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_title }}
      labels_json: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.labels_json }}
      sender: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.sender }}
      target_ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_ref }}
      target_sha: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_sha }}
    secrets:
      OPENCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
      OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON }}
      AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY: ${{ secrets.AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY }}
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D rugby web game with kicking, tackling, and running mechanics, customizable players, and user-created tactics/set plays. The user explicitly asked to build it now without clarifying questions.

## Requirements
- 2D rugby gameplay with kicking, tackle, and running mechanics.
- Player customization.
- Ability to create custom tactics and moves.
- Complete, playable game delivered in the current repo.
- Make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly at the end.

## Decisions
- Vanilla JS ES modules + Canvas 2D on a static `index.html`; no external assets or build step.
- Arcade 7-a-side rugby union: backward passes, punts/grubbers, tackles, rucks, lineouts, scrums, tries (5), conversions (2), halves.
- Player customization: 10-player squad, six attributes with a 46-point budget, traits, appearance (skin/hair/build/headgear), club kit/colors/pattern.
- Custom tactics: four attacking presets and four defensive presets that alter AI shape/behaviour.
- Custom moves: Playbook set-play editor with draggable starting positions, click-to-add routes, first-receiver assignment, up to 4 plays equipped to keys 1–4; plays execute with route running and an automatic first pass.
- Procedural audio via WebAudio (crowd, whistle, kicks, tackles, try/conversion sounds).
- Menu uses an attract-mode pitch scene; HUD is DOM; pitch/players/effects/minimap are canvas.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` with all screens: menu, match setup, squad builder, playbook, help, settings, HUD, touch controls, modal overlay.
- `styles.css` complete responsive sports-broadcast visual system, touch controls, safe-area support.
- `src/utils.js` math, formatting, color helpers.
- `src/data.js` stats, traits, positions, default squad/team, opponents, tactics presets, 3 default set plays, tips/commentary.
- `src/storage.js` localStorage save/load/sanitize.
- `src/audio.js` procedural sound manager.
- `src/input.js` keyboard + touch/joystick input with press/release edges.
- `src/engine.js` complete match simulation: kickoff, passing/kicking, ball physics, tackles/contact/offloads, rucks, lineouts/scrums with QTE, tries/conversions, halves, substitutions, AI, set plays, effects. `node --check` passes.
- `src/renderer.js` partially written: player sprite, portrait, tactics diagram, play editor drawing exported.

### Active
- `src/renderer.js` still needs the main `Renderer` class (pitch, stadium, camera, HUD overlays, effects, minimap, set-piece/conversion UI, attract mode) and default export/import wiring.
- `src/ui.js` not yet created: screen routing, squad editor, playbook editor interactions, match HUD updates, overlays.
- `src/main.js` not yet created: loop, match lifecycle, renderer/UI/input wiring, settings persistence.

### Blocked
- None known.

## Next Move
1. Finish `src/renderer.js`: implement `export class Renderer` with resize/DPR, camera, pitch/stadium/lines/posts, player sorting, ball, aim/landing indicators, set-play route overlays, particles/rings/floaters, set-piece timing bar, conversion power bar/posts/flight, minimap, rain/night, screen flash/shake, `renderMenu(dt)` attract scene.
2. Create `src/ui.js`: screen navigation, render roster/editor/preview, kit controls, tactics cards/diagram/readout, play list/equip slots, play editor pointer interactions, HUD updates, commentary/toasts/banners, pause/halftime/fulltime overlays.
3. Create `src/main.js`: attach input, audio init on gesture, save loading, screen switching, match creation with equipped plays, fixed-ish RAF loop, input.endFrame, menu attract mode.
4. Run a local server and Playwright screenshots; verify menu, squad, playbook, gameplay, and check console for runtime errors; fix visual/behavioral issues.
5. Verify custom play save/execute, kicking/passing/tackle/ruck/set pieces/conversions, mobile touch layout.
6. Update `README.md` with game/controls/assumptions summary.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: all UI screens, HUD, touch markup.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: complete visual system/responsive layout.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/engine.js`: match simulation, rules, AI, set plays, FX; ~2309 lines.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/renderer.js`: partial renderer; needs `Renderer` class + attract mode.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data.js`: game data/model and default content.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/input.js`: keyboard/touch mapping.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: procedural sounds.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/storage.js`: persistence schema/localStorage.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/utils.js`: helpers used everywhere.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: still default harness readme.

## Important Context
- Static project served by harness on port 3000 (`PORT` env, default 3000); `start.sh` uses runtime default static server. Use `playwright-cli` for browser checks; server should be run in a persistent session, not a bounded background command.
- `index.html` expects `./src/main.js`; `styles.css` expects all IDs/classes present in the HTML.
- `engine.js` exports `FIELD`, `Player`, `Match`; `Match` API: `update(dt)`, `startSecondHalf()`, `finishMatch()`, `buildResults()`, `triggerPlay(index)`, `equippedPlays` passed via constructor opts, events via `opts.onEvent(type,data)`. Event types include `kickoff`, `score`, `toast`, `commentary`, `banner`, `halftime`, `fulltime`.
- `renderer.js` imports `FIELD` from engine and `POSITION_BY_ID` from data; exports `drawPlayerSprite`, `drawPortrait`, `drawTacticsDiagram`, `playEditorTransform`, `drawPlayEditor`.
- Potential engine quirks to verify: user-team AI support and control switching; auto first pass in `updateActivePlay`; conversion camera state; set-piece bar stop for defending user; player/ball drawing positions during contact/ruck.
- `data.js` has no `round` import anymore; all checked files parse. `engine.js` includes a fixed comment string and no double-scoring on in-goal pickup (was patched).
- Assumed game name: **RUCKUS RUGBY**, 7-a-side, 3-minute halves default, Pro difficulty, clear weather.
- Repo has no `package.json`; must work as plain static HTML/JS.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D rugby web game with kicking, tackling and running mechanics, player customization, and user-created tactics/set plays. The user asked to build it immediately without clarifying questions.

## Requirements
- 2D rugby gameplay with kicking, tackle and running mechanics.
- Player customization.
- Ability to create custom tactics and moves.
- Complete, playable game delivered in the current repo.
- Make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly at the end.

## Decisions
- Vanilla JS ES modules + Canvas 2D on static `index.html`; no external assets/build step.
- Arcade 7-a-side rugby union: backward passes, punts/grubbers, tackles, rucks, lineouts, scrums, tries (5), conversions (2), halves.
- Player customization: 10-player squad, six attributes with a 46-point per-player budget, traits, appearance (skin/hair/build/headgear), club kit/colors/pattern.
- Custom tactics: five attacking presets and four defensive presets altering AI shape/behaviour.
- Custom moves: Playbook set-play editor with draggable starting positions, click-to-add routes, first-receiver assignment, up to 4 equipped plays on keys 1–4.
- Procedural WebAudio for crowd, whistle, kicks, tackles, tries and conversions.
- Menu uses an attract-mode pitch scene; HUD is DOM; pitch/players/effects/minimap are canvas.
- Game name assumed: **RUCKUS RUGBY**.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` with all screens: menu, match setup, squad builder, playbook, help, settings, HUD, touch controls, modal overlay.
- `styles.css` complete responsive sports-broadcast visual system, touch controls, safe-area support; `.mini-btn` now has `pointer-events: auto` so pause is clickable.
- `src/utils.js`, `src/data.js`, `src/storage.js`, `src/audio.js`, `src/input.js` complete.
- `src/engine.js` complete match simulation; fixed invalid four-backtick template literal at line ~1388 that caused browser-only `Unexpected identifier '$'`.
- `src/renderer.js` now complete: exported art helpers plus `Renderer` class with DPR resize, follow camera, stadium/crowd/ad boards, pitch/lines/posts, players/ball/effects, aim/landing indicators, set-play routes, set-piece/conversion UI, minimap, rain/night, shake/flash, and menu attract mode.
- `src/ui.js` complete: screen routing, setup, squad editor, playbook/tactics/set-play editor interactions, persistence, HUD state, commentary/toasts/banners, pause/halftime/fulltime overlays, touch controls, settings.
- `src/main.js` complete: save loading, match lifecycle, renderer/UI/input wiring, fixed-cap RAF loop, pause/visibility handling, audio unlock, debug `window.__ruckus`.
- All modules import successfully under Node; all files pass `node --check`.
- Browser verified at 1440×900: menu, setup, squad builder, tactics, set-play editor, kickoff/gameplay, HUD, minimap and context widgets render.
- Playwright/Chromium installed; static server running on port 3000 via tmux session `ruckus`.

### Active
- Browser QA and bug-fixing after initial screenshots.
- Need to verify actual play flow over time, custom play execution, set pieces, conversions, pause overlays and mobile layout.
- `README.md` still the default harness readme; game/controls/assumptions not yet documented.

### Blocked
- None known.

## Next Move
1. Reload browser with a cache-busting URL (e.g. `http://localhost:3000/?v=3`) because Chromium has cached old JS modules; confirm console is clean apart from missing favicon.
2. Use `window.__ruckus` to inspect match state and run/extend gameplay: verify passing, kicking, tackles/rucks, lineouts/scrums, tries, conversion UI, halftime/fulltime overlays, restart/quit, pause button.
3. Exercise Playbook interactions: drag players, add/undo routes, change receiver, save new/duplicate/delete plays, equip slots 1–4, then trigger a custom play in-match and confirm automatic first pass.
4. Test mobile/touch viewport (e.g. 390×844), safe areas, joystick and action buttons; fix layout/overlap issues.
5. Improve any glaring visual issues found (player scale/sparse midfield view are candidates) without breaking gameplay.
6. Replace `README.md` with game overview, controls, customization/playbook instructions, and brief assumptions.
7. Final pass: no console errors, no broken screens, note any remaining assumptions in the delivery message.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: loop/lifecycle, match creation, pause/quit/restart, debug handle.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js`: all screen/UI/HUD/overlay interactions; largest likely source of polish bugs.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/renderer.js`: complete canvas renderer; verify visual/camera/UI drawing.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/engine.js`: gameplay/AI/rules/set pieces/play execution/events.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: screen markup and HUD IDs used heavily by UI.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: responsive layout and touch/HUD styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data.js`: squads, opponents, stats, tactics, default plays.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/storage.js`: localStorage save schema and sanitization.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: still needs the real game documentation.

## Important Context
- Static server: `python3 -m http.server 3000` in tmux session `ruckus`; browser opened with Playwright CLI.
- Chromium caches `src/engine.js`; a normal reload served the old syntax error. Navigate with a query string such as `http://localhost:3000/?v=3` after JS edits, or use cache-busted imports.
- Verify all imports with `node -e "import('./src/ui.js')..."`; `node --check` alone missed the engine syntax error that Node’s ESM loader caught.
- `Match` API: `update(dt)`, `startSecondHalf()`, `finishMatch()`, `buildSnapshot()`, `buildResults()`, `triggerPlay(index)`, `predictLanding()`, `stopSetpieceBar()`, `lockConversion()`.
- Engine events: `kickoff`, `score`, `toast`, `commentary`, `banner`, `halftime`, `fulltime`; `onEvent(type,data)`.
- Engine state values: `kickoff`, `play`, `contact`, `ruck`, `lineout`, `scrum`, `try`, `conversion`, `halftime`, `fulltime`.
- `FIELD = { minX:-10, maxX:110, minY:0, maxY:70, leftTry:0, rightTry:100, inGoal:10 }`; try zones are `[-10,0]` and `[100,110]`.
- Equipped plays are passed as a 4-length array with `null` placeholders to preserve key positions; main maps save IDs accordingly.
- `window.__ruckus` exposes `{ match, lastSettings, ui, renderer, save, startMatch, restartMatch }` for automated checks.
- Current browser screenshots saved under `screenshots/`: menu3, setup, squad, playbook-tactics, playbook-plays, game-kickoff, game-charge, game-play.
- Repo has no `package.json`; must remain plain static HTML/JS. Changes are untracked/uncommitted at this point.

const eq = Array.from({length:4}, (_,i)=> raw.equipped[i] valid ? id : null);

const eq = Array.isArray(this.save.equipped) ? this.save.equipped.slice(0,4) : [];

this.save.equipped = eq.map(id => this.save.plays.some(p=>p.id===id) ? id : null);
```
This preserves null holes and invalid entries become null.

# RUCKUS RUGBY

A complete, playable 2D arcade rugby game for the browser. Build a squad, design your own set plays, pick a game plan and take the field in fast 7-a-side rugby union.

Everything is vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript — no build step, no external assets, no network calls. The pitch, players, crowd and audio are all generated in the browser.

## Play it

Open `index.html` through any static web server:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 3000
# then open http://localhost:3000
```

Or serve the folder with any static host. Opening the file directly from disk also works in most browsers, but a local server is recommended for ES modules and save data.

## What is in the game

- **7-a-side rugby union** with tries (5 points), conversions (2), halves, kick-offs, lineouts, scrums, rucks, knock-ons, forward passes, touch and 22 drop-outs.
- **Running, passing, kicking and tackling** — sprint, sidestep, offload in contact and contest the breakdown.
- **Squad Builder** — ten-player squad, six attributes per player, traits and a point budget, plus appearance (skin, hair, hair style, build, headgear) and club identity (name, abbreviation, jersey pattern and colours).
- **Playbook** — five attacking shapes, four defensive systems and a full set-play editor. Drag starting positions, draw running lines, choose the first receiver and equip up to four moves to keys 1–4.
- **Matchday** — four opponents, three difficulties, three weather conditions and three half lengths.
- **Presentation** — broadcast HUD, commentary, minimap, aim/landing indicators, rain and night conditions, procedural sound and a live attract-mode menu scene.
- **Local saves** — your club, squad, tactics, plays and settings persist in `localStorage`.

## Controls

| Action | Keyboard | Touch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Move | `W` `A` `S` `D` / arrow keys | Drag the left joystick |
| Sprint | `Shift` | SPRINT |
| Pass | `J` or `Z` | PASS |
| Kick | Hold `K` or `X`, release to boot | Hold/release KICK |
| Tackle / dive | `L`, `C` or `Space` | TACKLE |
| Sidestep (carrying) | `L` / `C` / `Space` | STEP |
| Switch defender | `Q` | SWITCH |
| Offload in contact | `E` | — |
| Trigger set play | `1` `2` `3` `4` | Tactics row |
| Pause | `Esc` or `P` | II button |

Kicking is contextual: tap for a grubber, hold for a punt. In open play the aim follows your movement stick. On kick-offs, hold and release to launch. At a lineout or scrum, tap PASS/TACKLE/KICK while the timing bar is in the green zone. At a conversion, stop the power bar in the highlighted window.

## Set plays in 60 seconds

1. Open **Playbook → Set Plays & Moves**.
2. Pick a play or press **+ New**.
3. Click a teammate token, then click upfield to add a run. Drag tokens to move their starting positions.
4. Choose the **First receiver** — they receive an automatic pass when the move starts.
5. Use **Undo point**, **Clear run** or **Reset shape** to tidy up.
6. Assign plays to **Matchday Keys 1–4** with the dropdowns.
7. In a match, press `1`–`4` (or tap the tactic buttons) while your team has the ball. Teammates break to their lines and the first receiver gets the ball automatically.

## Project layout

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `index.html` | Screens, HUD, touch controls and modal shell |
| `styles.css` | Responsive broadcast-style visual system |
| `src/main.js` | Bootstrap, match lifecycle and fixed-step render loop |
| `src/engine.js` | Simulation: rules, AI, rucks, set pieces, plays, scoring |
| `src/renderer.js` | Canvas stadium, pitch, players, effects and camera |
| `src/ui.js` | Screen routing, builders, playbook editor and HUD |
| `src/data.js` | Default squads, opponents, attributes, tactics and plays |
| `src/storage.js` | Versioned, sanitised `localStorage` saves |
| `src/input.js` | Keyboard and touch input |
| `src/audio.js` | Procedural WebAudio crowd and effects |
| `src/utils.js` | Shared math, formatting and helper functions |

## Notes and assumptions

- The game is an **arcade interpretation** of rugby union, tuned for 7-a-side and short sessions. It is not a referee-accurate simulation.
- Default halves are **3 minutes**; match setup can switch to 1:30 or 5:00.
- The squad has **ten players** (seven starters plus three bench) and each player has a **46-point attribute budget** shared across the starting squad.
- Set plays are authored against a 6-teammate shape relative to the ball carrier, so the same design adapts to either direction of play.
- All art and audio are procedural; there are no external asset downloads, fonts or network dependencies.
- Saves are per-browser/device. Use **Settings → Delete save** to start fresh.
- The repository intentionally has **no package manager or build step**. Serve the files as-is.

## QA checklist

- Menu, setup, squad builder, playbook, help and settings screens.
- Kick-off, open play, contact, rucks, lineouts, scrums, tries, conversions, half-time and full-time.
- Custom plays: drag/draw/duplicate/delete, equip to keys, auto first pass in a match.
- Keyboard and touch control paths, pause/restart/quit, mobile portrait layout and safe areas.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D rugby web game with kicking, tackling and running mechanics, player customization, and user-created tactics/set plays, delivered directly in the current repo.

## Requirements
- 2D rugby gameplay with kicking, tackle and running mechanics.
- Player customization.
- Ability to create custom tactics and moves.
- Complete, playable game delivered in the current repo.
- Make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly at the end; build immediately without clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Vanilla JS ES modules + Canvas 2D on static `index.html`; no external assets/build step.
- Arcade 7-a-side rugby union with tries (5), conversions (2), halves, kick-offs, lineouts, scrums, rucks, knock-ons, forward passes, touch and 22 drop-outs.
- Player customization: 10-player squad (7 starters + 3 bench), six attributes with a 46-point per-player budget, traits, appearance, club kit/colors/pattern.
- Five attacking presets and four defensive presets drive AI shape/behaviour.
- Playbook set-play editor with draggable starting positions, up to 8 route points per player, first-receiver assignment, duplicate/delete, and four equipped plays on keys 1–4.
- Procedural WebAudio for crowd, whistle, kicks, tackles, tries and conversions.
- Menu uses attract-mode pitch scene; HUD is DOM; pitch/players/effects/minimap are canvas.
- Game name assumed: **RUCKUS RUGBY**; default halves 3:00.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html`, `styles.css`, `src/utils.js`, `src/data.js`, `src/storage.js`, `src/audio.js`, `src/input.js`, `src/engine.js`, `src/renderer.js`, `src/ui.js`, `src/main.js`, `favicon.svg`, and full `README.md`.
- Fixed engine syntax error, browser runtime errors, and favicon 404s.
- Player movement, passing, kicking, tackling, offloads, sidesteps, rucks, lineouts, scrums, tries, conversions, halftime, fulltime, restart, pause and quit verified.
- Custom play trigger via keyboard and touch verified; automatic first pass confirmed; tactics presets confirmed wired into AI.
- Set-play UI cleaned up: removed duplicate center-screen play-name toast; non-receiver routes now faint and route overlay stops after 3.4s.
- Camera improved: larger players, better portrait framing (`visibleW 32 / visibleH 60`), landscape `58 / 38`, using zoom-in `Math.max` logic.
- Touch kick bug fixed so quick taps also kick; `setPointerCapture` guarded against synthetic pointers.
- Touch tactic buttons fixed via event delegation after HUD re-renders.
- Equipped play slots now preserve null gaps across reload in both `ui.ensureEquipped()` and `storage.sanitizeSave()`.
- Metres now tracked for both teams, fixing away-team `0m` stats.
- Mobile horizontal overflow fixed for Squad Builder and Playbook; no horizontal overflow at 390×844 on any screen.
- Full simulated 2×90s match reached fulltime cleanly with no NaN/console errors; halftime, results stats and MOTM render correctly.
- QA screenshots removed; `screenshots/` remains gitignored.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Send the final delivery message summarizing the game, how to run it, controls, and the noted assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: all screens, HUD, touch controls, favicon links.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: responsive visual system and mobile fixes.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/engine.js`: match simulation, rules, AI, set pieces, plays, scoring.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js`: screen routing, squad/playbook editing, HUD, overlays.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/renderer.js`: canvas pitch/stadium/players/effects/camera.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: lifecycle, RAF loop, debug handle.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data.js`: squads, opponents, stat/tactics/play defaults.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/storage.js`: versioned sanitized `localStorage` saves.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/input.js`: keyboard/touch input and delegated touch tactics.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: procedural WebAudio.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/utils.js`: shared helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/favicon.svg`: brand favicon; removes 404.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: game overview, controls, playbook instructions, assumptions.
- `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/node_modules/playwright`: usable Playwright install for further browser QA.

## Important Context
- Static server on `http://localhost:3000` via tmux session `ruckus`; repo has no `package.json` and must remain static HTML/JS/CSS.
- Use cache-busting URLs such as `http://localhost:3000/?v=3` during QA; Chromium caches old ES modules.

1: # RUCKUS RUGBY
2: 
3: A complete, playable 2D arcade rugby game for the browser. Build a squad, design your own set plays, pick a game plan and take the field in fast 7-a-side rugby union.
4: 
5: Everything is vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript — no build step, no external assets, no network calls. The pitch, players, crowd and audio are all generated in the browser.
6: 
7: ## Play it
8: 
9: Open `index.html` through any static web server:
10: 
11: ```bash
12: python3 -m http.server 3000
13: # then open http://localhost:3000
14: ```
15: 
16: Or serve the folder with any static host. Opening the file directly from disk also works in most browsers, but a local server is recommended for ES modules and save data.
17: 
18: ## What is in the game
19: 
20: - **7-a-side rugby union** with tries (5 points), conversions (2), halves, kick-offs, lineouts, scrums, rucks, knock-ons, forward passes, touch and 22 drop-outs.
21: - **Running, passing, kicking and tackling** — sprint, sidestep, offload in contact and contest the breakdown.
22: - **Squad Builder** — ten-player squad, six attributes per player, traits and a point budget, plus appearance (skin, hair, hair style, build, headgear) and club identity (name, abbreviation, jersey pattern and colours).
23: - **Playbook** — five attacking shapes, four defensive systems and a full set-play editor. Drag starting positions, draw running lines, choose the first receiver and equip up to four moves to keys 1–4.
24: - **Matchday** — four opponents, three difficulties, three weather conditions and three half lengths.
25: - **Presentation** — broadcast HUD, commentary, minimap, aim/landing indicators, rain and night conditions, procedural sound and a live attract-mode menu scene.
26: - **Local saves** — your club, squad, tactics, plays and settings persist in `localStorage`.
27: 
28: ## Controls
29: 
30: | Action | Keyboard | Touch |
31: | --- | --- | --- |
32: | Move | `W` `A` `S` `D` / arrow keys | Drag the left joystick |
33: | Sprint | `Shift` | SPRINT |
34: | Pass | `J` or `Z` | PASS |
35: | Kick | Hold `K` or `X`, release to boot | Hold/release KICK |
36: | Tackle / dive | `L`, `C` or `Space` | TACKLE |
37: | Sidestep (carrying) | `L` / `C` / `Space` | STEP |
38: | Switch defender | `Q` | SWITCH |
39: | Offload in contact | `E` | — |
40: | Trigger set play | `1` `2` `3` `4` | Tactics row |
41: | Pause | `Esc` or `P` | II button |
42: 
43: Kicking is contextual: tap for a grubber, hold for a punt. In open play the aim follows your movement stick. On kick-offs, hold and release to launch. At a lineout or scrum, tap PASS/TACKLE/KICK while the timing bar is in the green zone. At a conversion, stop the power bar in the highlighted window.
44: 
45: ## Set plays in 60 seconds
46: 
47: 1. Open **Playbook → Set Plays & Moves**.
48: 2. Pick a play or press **+ New**.
49: 3. Click a teammate token, then click upfield to add a run. Drag tokens to move their starting positions.
50: 4. Choose the **First receiver** — they receive an automatic pass when the move starts.
51: 5. Use **Undo point**, **Clear run** or **Reset shape** to tidy up.
52: 6. Assign plays to **Matchday Keys 1–4** with the dropdowns.
53: 7. In a match, press `1`–`4` (or tap the tactic buttons) while your team has the ball. Teammates break to their lines and the first receiver gets the ball automatically.
